string.text: Kingdom recruits, militia, factions, mercenaries, gangsters, marines, caravans, and conspiracy. Off disables every Troops group.
Looters, sea/mountain/forest/desert/steppe bandits, corsairs, Army of Poachers, and HorseBandits when that mod is enabled. Off disables every Bandits group.
Chance a new HorseBandits troop is female (pillager/ransacker lines, Chief, Boss). Default 25. Off or 0 keeps them male. Only shown when HorseBandits is enabled.
Chance a new town, village, or castle recruit of this culture is female (regular and noble). Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new recruits male.
Chance a new town, village, or castle recruit of this culture is female (regular and noble). Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new recruits male. Reopen the encyclopedia after changing this.
Chance a new militia troop of this culture is female. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new militia male.
Chance a new troop of this faction is female. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new troops male.
Chance a new Sellsword, Outrider, Mercenary Maceman, Hired Spear, Hired Pike, or Hired Crossbow is female. Default 25. Sword Sisters stay vanilla. Off or 0 keeps those lines male.
Chance a new gangster is female. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new gangsters male.

Chance a new marine of this culture is female, and whether female land troops can upgrade into that marine line. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps marines male and removes that upgrade. Reopen the encyclopedia after changing this.
Chance a new troop of this bandit line is female, including bosses and hideouts. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new troops male.
Chance a new Looter is female, including hideouts. Deserters use Looters, so they follow this. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps new Looters male.
Chance a new Sea Raider is female, including chiefs, bosses, and hideouts. Northern pirates use these troops. Default 25. With War Sails, upgrades follow the Nord line.
Chance a new Corsair is female. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps them male. Needs War Sails.
Chance a new Poacher in the Army of Poachers quest is female. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps them male.
Chance a new Armed Trader or Caravan Guard is female. Also covers Smugglers parties and War Sails naval/convoy caravans. Default 25. Nord/naval need War Sails.
Chance a new troop in these Story Mode conspiracy parties is female. Default 25. Off or 0 keeps them male.
